title: BackBitting hahahahaha
subtitle: A concise collection of practical notes, experiments, and ideas for people building what comes next.

sections.text: Share the questions, experiments, and small decisions behind the work. An open process gives others something useful to learn from.
A rough draft can invite better feedback than a polished reveal. Let people see what you are testing and where you are still uncertain.
Keep showing up with honest progress. Small, regular updates make it easier for people to follow along and contribute.

sections.header: Make feedback part of the process
sections.text: Ask clear questions, listen closely, and explain what changed. Good collaboration turns outside perspective into better work.

sections.header: Leave a trail others can follow
sections.text: Document what worked and what did not. Sharing the path makes the next attempt easier for you and for the people who come after.

moksha.closing: The next draft starts in the open.
